PRODUCT_TANKER_TONMILES.summary: Evidence from a Bloomberg‑reported shipping fixture indicates longer voyages and tighter supply for refined‑product cargoes.

evidence.claim: Diesel supply routes to north‑west Europe are stretching up to 19,000 km, showing that refined‑product cargoes are traveling materially farther than before.
evidence.why_upstream: The article cites a specific LR2 product tanker (Priamos) carrying diesel on a 19,000 km route, directly evidencing longer product‑tanker voyages.
evidence.source_name: Europe’s diesel squeeze deepens as supply routes stretch 19,000 km | trans.info

evidence.claim: European diesel refining margins have risen above $100 per barrel and ARA gasoil stocks have fallen to a four‑year low, indicating a tightening of effective product‑tanker fleet supply.
evidence.why_upstream: Higher margins and low gasoil inventories, reported alongside the long‑haul shipment, signal constrained product‑tanker capacity.
